name: Registry Mode Stub
description: Distribution's filesystem-storage default behaviour (writable private registry) is wrong for our use case: every blob GET schedules a 7-day TTL cleanup; after the TTL the blob link AND the data file get unlinked. Result: a pull-through cache that slowly self-destructs even with no external DELETE calls (see /var/log/lxc/<host>-<vmid>.log: 'Scheduler error returned from OnExpire(...): Path not found'). This pre-start template patches /etc/distribution/config.yml to the mode declared by the locked `mirror_mode` property (today: 'proxy'). The patch happens on the host filesystem before the LXC starts; the env vars (REGISTRY_PROXY_REMOTEURL etc., set via the application's `envs` property) only take effect once their parent `proxy:` section exists in the config file — without this stub they are silently ignored and the registry boots in the broken filesystem-storage mode. Idempotent: skipped if the file already declares the requested mode.
